minimal_algorithm.rule: Build expected annual candidates and events from complete original catalogs/targets, including failed/unissued files. Never infer complete version chain from successful prepared documents only.

At decision t use only publicdate<t. Pick latest report year then latest full version date within that year. Latest expected full identity/parse failure remains unknown; no older fallback. Same-day dependent-field conflicts remain unknown.

Require same-report current consolidated dependent fields, period/unit/currency/scale qualification, positive assets,16-calendar-month age. Different candidate dependencies remain separate. Do not repair multicurrency ambiguity by changing this notice rule.

Apply accepted exact-document decisions first: proven irrelevant clears only its scope; known nonmatching year/field is ignored; matching unresolved current year/field blocks unless a qualified full version has bound resolution evidence. Existing six accepted notice decisions remain intact.
Do not treat ambiguous full annual year/issuer/identity as generic notice. Those are source/version identity failures and cannot expire through this heuristic.

For an unreviewed generic correction event E with known issuer/publicdate, compare selected qualified annual A. If A.fiscalend>E.publicdate AND A.publicdate>E.publicdate, allow only new current-period measurement, recording every event as unreviewed_prior_notice and the exact recovery reason. Do not change continuing_scope to cleared or disposition to unrelated.

If either date comparison fails, event remains an active unresolved blocker pending source review. This deliberately retains a bounded conservative interval; it does not infer same-year notices harmless just because a later publication exists.

No recovery overrides a known current-period field conflict, recalled/replaced current annual without a qualified replacement, explicitly undetermined current values, or same-day contradiction. A generic investigation/audit/reliability warning alone is a descriptive flag under the frozen no-new-audit-screen scope.
All selected annuals/events themselves must be known by t. A later new annual never repairs past unknown months. No issuer-wide future completeness filter. Retain all600x132 rows.

minimum_still_needed_evidence.active_notice_set: For each otherwise qualified row union all unresolved events that fail the two new-period date conditions, plus events with known explicit current-year/field scope and ambiguous annual identity. Deduplicate issuer+ID/hash; do not review only rows with one blocker.
minimum_still_needed_evidence.old_unreviewed_events: No full semantic review prerequisite solely to allow new-current-period measurement. Preserve original ID/date/source availability and unreviewed status. Missing old event date/issuer prevents safe timing comparison and stays unknown.
minimum_still_needed_evidence.priority_triage: Source searches for explicit current-report withdrawal, undetermined amounts and named future periods can prioritize manual source review; absence of keywords is not asserted as clearance. Prioritize by affected otherwise-qualified rows, never financial score/rank/returns.
minimum_still_needed_evidence.bound_current_report_checks: If a review does reveal explicit unresolved current-period conflict, record it consistently for all rows after its actual publicdate; never discard it to keep coverage.
minimum_still_needed_evidence.no_extra_effect_branch: Persist strict-source diagnostics and restored-row counts. Do not silently add strict-vs-recovered return variants or choose whichever performs better; any such financial follow-up needs registered purpose and budget.
